author: Karmen Foskulo
text: Great host, beautiful place, clean and really domestic feel with all modern benefits. Love it.

author: Camilla Kristiansen
text: Very beautiful place and fantastic for big families who are traveling together.

author: Solene F
text: Very nice place, the view is superb and the place cosy.

author: Alexia Ennesser
text: Beautiful house, beautiful setting. Very kind owners. If you go, you won't be disappointed. Authenticity guaranteed.

author: Istvan Toth Gy.
text: The most peaceful place in Croatia with a beautiful view. Perfect for a family of three. It was a real rest. Cold drinks, palm trees.

author: Alex, Jack & Sam
text: We love the villa, we love Podobuce and we love Croatia - so much that we're considering re-locating! Thank you Villa Dvori for a fantastic holiday.

author: Lorraine & Dan
text: We have had the most relaxing time on holiday in Croatia made perfect by the facilities at Villa Dvori and the idyllic location. The pool, the terraces and the rooms were perfect for our different family needs. Thank you.

author: Mike, Janet & co.
text: We have an amazing time at Villa Dvori. Croatia is a lovely country, weather has been fantastic. Enjoyed the pool and being able to eat outside. Podobuce is a lovely village, we recommend the restaurant, the local fish is delicious and the view fantastic. Thank you Sanda and Sinisa.

author: Milka & co.
text: Three families from Finland met in the lovely village of Podobuce. Wonderful place and great time!

author: Martin & co.
text: Thank you for a lovely stay in Podobuce! Croatia is salty, watery, tasty, beautiful, warm, friendly and for sure a country to return to. Both kids and grownups are happy with the stay!

author: Liz, Simon & co.
text: We have had a fantastic week at Villa Dvori. Comfortable accommodation and a beautiful garden, with sun and shade to suit everyone. Had lovely outdoor meals, enjoyed the pool, and the village. Went to Korcula, Mljet, Dubrovnik, hired boats, snorkelled in the bay.

author: The Gilchrist Family
text: What a place! What a fantastic setting for a family holiday! We had great expectations of Croatia from South Africa and we certainly weren't disappointed. Thanks Sanda for opening your house to us.

author: Dave & Victoria
text: What a fabulous place to stay! Villa Dvori exceeded all expectations - fantastic weather, beautiful surroundings - and the perfect venue for our vow renewal ceremony. We will be coming back!

author: Liz & Simon
text: And we did return! We couldn't keep away, so booked a longer stay this year. Once again we've had an amazing stay here at Villa Dvori, and can't wait to come back again.

author: Ellien, Nicki & co.
text: We have really enjoyed being in Croatia and staying in Podobuce! We really liked Korcula and jumping off the jetty in the village. Thank you so much for being so helpful and welcoming.
